related.title: 交換量子位元甜蜜點：二階電壓敏感度
related.titleEn: Exchange-qubit sweet spots: second-order voltage sensitivity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只有時間序列殘差無結構且起始對比獨立校準後，才將變化歸因於T₂*。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Attribute changes toT2* only after unstructured residuals and independent initial-contrast calibration. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 說明一階導數為零仍留下二階頻移，分開零均值雜訊與零偏差。
related.differenceEn: Explain why a zero first derivative still leaves second-order frequency shifts; zero-mean noise need not mean zero bias.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。延遲t=10μs，T₂*=20μs，起始對比已正規化為1。 C=exp[−(10/20)²]。 代入 exp(-(10/20)**2)，得到 0.778801 normalized contrast。準靜態高斯失諧下取C(t)=exp[−(t/T₂*)²]；這是歸一化包絡，非完整振盪訊號。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。κ=10MHz/mV²，靜態電壓偏差δV=0.1mV。 Δf=0.5×κ×δV²。 代入 0.5*10*0.1**2，得到 0.05 MHz。甜蜜點附近f(V)=f₀+κδV²/2，κ固定且三階項忽略；超出局部範圍不可外插。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Delayt=10μs, T2*=20μs and normalized initial contrast1. C=exp[−(10/20)²]. Substituting exp(-(10/20)**2) gives 0.778801 normalized contrast. For quasistatic Gaussian detuning use C(t)=exp[−(t/T2*)²], a normalized envelope rather than the full oscillation. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. κ=10MHz/mV² and static voltage offsetδV=0.1mV. Δf=0.5×κ×δV². Substituting 0.5*10*0.1**2 gives 0.05 MHz. Near a sweet spot f(V)=f0+κδV²/2 with constantκ and neglected cubic terms; do not extrapolate beyond the local range. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: Protected-qubit system budgets: readout still matters

related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Attribute changes toT2* only after unstructured residuals and independent initial-contrast calibration. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 用聯集上界建立多來源失敗預算，避免把物理保護等同完整系統零錯誤。
related.differenceEn: Build a multisource failure budget with a union bound rather than equating physical protection with a flawless system.

Teaching per-cycle bounds: poisoning0.001, readout0.002 and control0.0005 with categories defined. Total bound=0.001+0.002+0.0005. Substituting 0.001+0.002+0.0005 gives 0.0035 probability upper bound. P(any failure)≤Σpi without independence; overlapping events make the bound conservative, while exact summation requires disjoint events.
